title: Title
matchPatternDescription: When input matches this regex, open directly without secondary input.
faviconCache.description: Site icons stored inside this plugin for launcher results. Remove individual entries or clear all.
faviconCache.empty: No cached favicons yet. They appear after you use web quick open.
queryHistory.description: Recorded query parameters per rule. Clear history for a rule here.
queryHistory.empty: No query history yet. Enable “Remember query history” on a rule and open successfully.
settings.installHelp: Chrome / Edge block silent install. Package: plugins/builtin/web-open/extension — open it and use Load unpacked.
settings.installSteps:
1. Click “Open extension folder”
2. Chrome / Edge → Extensions → enable Developer mode
3. “Load unpacked” → select the folder that opened
4. Refresh status here — it should show Connected
settings.enableSearchHelp: When on, this plugin registers browser.chromium with the host (same Desktop Target protocol as future Feishu adapters).
settings.enableSearchToggle: Register tab source with Global Launcher
settings.historyHelp: When on, the extension sends recent history to Hiven for launcher search and background learning. Raw URLs stay local.
settings.idleHelp: Close background tabs that have stayed inactive longer than the timeout. Pinned, audible, and the last tab in a window are never closed.
settings.footer: Empty search never lists tabs; type a title or URL fragment. When disconnected, results stay silent. After this update, reload the unpacked extension so Chrome grants History access.
settings.reloadHint: After this update, reload the unpacked extension so Chrome grants the new History permission.
